CARDRPG.Slot.Head: Head
CARDRPG.Trigger.AllyHit: an ally within reach is hit
CARDRPG.Trigger.Arrival: an enemy ends its move next to you
CARDRPG.Settings.ShowFateSwing.Name: Show fate swing chance
CARDRPG.Settings.ShowFateSwing.Hint: Display the computed chance that the next fate draw is a Miss or Critical. Some tables want the arithmetic surfaced, others find it clinical.
CARDRPG.Settings.ShowNpcHealth.Name: Players see NPC health
CARDRPG.Settings.ShowNpcHealth.Hint: Cowardly triggers below half Health and Weakest targets the lowest, so players need this to play against either. Turn it off for a more opaque table.
CARDRPG.Settings.HandSize.Name: Hand size
CARDRPG.Settings.HandSize.Hint: Cards drawn back to at the start of each round, before features.
CARDRPG.Settings.CarryLimit.Name: Carry limit (kg)
CARDRPG.Settings.CarryLimit.Hint: Base weight a character can carry before becoming Burdened, before features.
CARDRPG.Settings.OverloadedSpent.Name: Cards Spent while Overloaded
CARDRPG.Settings.OverloadedSpent.Hint: Random cards set aside while carrying over half again your limit. Measured at 2: about 7 points of win rate in a hard fight, 2 in a moderate one.
CARDRPG.Level.GmSaysWhenHint: The GM says when a level happens; there are no experience points. Until one is granted this pane is a map you can read and plan on.
CARDRPG.Level.Refit: Fit the whole graph in the pane
CARDRPG.Level.Hint: Click a node on your frontier to mark it. Marking another unmarks the first, and nothing is written until you accept.
CARDRPG.Level.NothingNumeric: No numbers: this node is its Signature.
CARDRPG.Level.Title: Title
CARDRPG.Level.Prune: Prune one card from a deck, permanently
CARDRPG.Level.NotYet: {name} is not on your frontier yet.
CARDRPG.Level.NoneToSpend: You have no level to spend. The GM says when.
CARDRPG.Level.NoCard: This node grants the card {name}, which has not been built yet. Tell your GM.
CARDRPG.Level.ConfirmBody: Taking {name} closes these for good, and everything behind them:
CARDRPG.Challenge.Title: Challenge
CARDRPG.Challenge.Body: Two tracks: how much you need to achieve, and how much can go wrong before it turns ugly.
CARDRPG.Challenge.Won: Progress full: you succeed, and the pressure left over is how cleanly.
CARDRPG.Challenge.Lost: Pressure full: it fails or it changes. This should open a new situation, not close the road.
CARDRPG.Challenge.BreatheBody: Pressure +1, your discard comes back, and you draw up to hand size. One card of your choice is set aside as Spent until your next rest.
CARDRPG.Twist.NoDeck: There is no twist deck in this world. Run the Card RPG setup macro.
CARDRPG.Ground.Trap: a trap: the first to enter sets it off
CARDRPG.Read.Other: Any one deck but your own
CARDRPG.While.OneCard: While your hand is exactly one card
CARDRPG.While.HandAndDeckEmpty: While hand and draw pile are both empty
CARDRPG.While.ThinDeck: While your action deck is 10 cards or fewer
CARDRPG.While.SpendSecondaryEachRound: While you spend a secondary each round
CARDRPG.Check.PassiveOver: they simply manage it, so there is nothing to check
CARDRPG.Check.PassiveClose: a card could carry it, so this is a check worth making
CARDRPG.Check.PassiveUnder: out of reach even with their best card in hand
CARDRPG.Check.CallBody: Name the obstacle. The difficulty is yours to set; the card is theirs to choose.
CARDRPG.Check.GMCalls: The GM calls for a check.
CARDRPG.Check.NoScene: There is no active scene to call a check in.
CARDRPG.Check.WaitForCall: The GM has not called for a check yet. Say what you are doing, and they will.
CARDRPG.Level.CharactersOnly: The levelling graph is for characters; NPCs do not level.
CARDRPG.Level.Expertise: Expertise ({approach}): raise one skill card of that approach by 1, to the cap of 3
CARDRPG.Level.Mastery: Mastery ({approach}): your passive score for it is 1 higher
CARDRPG.Level.ExpertiseBody: Raise one of your {approach} skill cards by 1. The cap is 3, so a card already at 3 cannot be raised — pick another, or take nothing and keep the offer for a card you have not got yet.
CARDRPG.Level.ExpertiseNone: You have no {approach} card below 3 to raise.
CARDRPG.Level.Choose: One formula of your choice from {source} ({n} to pick from)
CARDRPG.Level.ChooseBody: This node teaches one formula or miracle of your choice from this list. The number after each is its strength, which is what it costs out of your spell slots once you prepare it.
CARDRPG.Level.NothingLeft: You already know everything {source} has to teach.
CARDRPG.Level.PruneBody: This node lets you remove one card from your action deck, permanently. Which one has gone dead?
CARDRPG.Level.Pruned: {name} is gone from your deck for good.
CARDRPG.Level.PruneFloor: Your deck is already at its minimum of {min}; there is nothing to prune.
CARDRPG.Settings.GraphEditing.Name: Edit the levelling graph
CARDRPG.Settings.GraphEditing.Hint: Lets a GM change the graph itself from the level-up pane. Everything about a character derives from the nodes they own, so a changed node changes them with no warning: turn this on while authoring a world, not during a campaign.
CARDRPG.Level.GraphRefused: The levelling graph edits in this world were refused and core content is in use instead: {faults}
CARDRPG.Level.NoSpell: This node grants the formula {name}, which has not been built yet. Tell your GM.
CARDRPG.Level.NoSlate: This node grants {name}, which has not been built yet. Tell your GM.
CARDRPG.Foresee.Nothing: No intent card is in play for that type yet.
